title: Dengeki Daisy Reveals Main Trailer, Key Visual and 4 New Cast Members Ahead of January 2027 Release
content:
Dengeki Daisy anime revealed its first main trailer and key visual, four additional cast members, and a January 2027 release date. The anime will adapt the manga through its conclusion and stream on Crunchyroll. Two consecutive cours have been confirmed, meaning that the anime will run through Spring 2026.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Tomokazu Sugita as Soichiro Kurebayashi, Teru’s late older brother

• Yuka Terasaki as Riko Onizuka, a school counselor who previously worked with Soichiro and Kurosaki

• Setsuji Sato as Masuda, a café owner with ties to Soichiro and Kurosaki

• Kohei Amasaki as Akira, a mysterious boy who takes an interest in Teru

You can hear the cast in action in the new trailer.

The key visual also features all four characters alongside protagonists Teru Kurebayashi and Tasuku Kurosaki, voiced by Yoshino Aoyama and Taku Yashiro, respectively.

The story follows Teru Kurebayashi, a 16-year-old girl whose brother dies and leaves her with a phone connected to the mysterious hacker “Daisy.” The anime will be animated by Studio DEEN and directed by Sota Ueno, who previously directed Days with My Stepsister and Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table . The full credits include:

• Director: Sota Ueno

• Series Composition: Sawako Hirabayashi

• Character Design: Ayaka Murakami

• Music: Masaru Yokoyama

Dengeki Daisy is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Kyosuke Motomi. It was serialized in Shogakukan’s Betsucomi shojo magazine from May 2007 to October 2013, releasing a total of 16 volumes. Viz Media released the series in English, describing the story of Volume 1:

One day at school, Teru accidentally breaks a window and agrees to pay for it by helping Kurosaki with chores around school. Kurosaki is an impossible taskmaster though, and he also seems to be hiding something important from Teru… Motomi is also the author of QQ Sweeper and its sequel Queen’s Quality manga series, both of which were serialized in the same magazine. His currently ongoing series is Yaoyoruzu Toriatsukai Setsumeisho .
author: Anime Corner

title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Reveals Graduation Day Visual Ahead of Season 2 Finale
content:
You and I Are Polar Opposites anime has revealed a new Graduation Day visual as Season 2 approaches its final episodes. The graduation ceremony will be featured in Episode 24, airing on September 27, followed by the series finale, Episode 25, on October 4. As previously announced, there will not be an episode this week. Studio Lapin Track ( Undead Girl Murder Farce ) is animating. The anime previously revealed the main visual for the upcoming sequel. You can see the new visual below.

The staff members for the You and I Are Polar Opposites anime include:

• Director: Takakazu Nagatomo

• Series Composition & Animation Producer: Teruko Utsumi

• Character Design: Miyakomako (みやこまこ)

• Sub Character Design & Chief Animation Director: Naho Kozono

• Chief Animation Director: Sayuri Sakimoto, Tamami Izawa, Sara Sakoe

• Main Animator: Rie Maehara

• Art Director: Chieko Nakamura

• Color Setting: Yuki Akimoto

• Photography Direction: Tomoyuki Shiokawa

• 3D Director: Yuuji Koshida

• Editing: Masayuki Kurosawa

• 2D Design: Wataru Osakabe

• Music: tofubeats

• Sound Director: Eriko Kimura

• Animation Studio: Lapin Track

• Production Supervision: SHOCHIKU Anime

You and I Are Polar Opposites was originally published as a one-shot on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ in January 2021, before getting serialized in the same website starting in May 2022. It ended with a total of eight volumes. The manga is also available on the MANGA Plus website, which describes its story: Suzuki, an energetic girl who can’t help but follow the crowd, finds herself drawn to Tani, a quiet boy who can easily speak his mind. Enter: the serialization of a hit one-shot! A story for anyone who wants to enjoy love! This down-to-earth, relatable rom-com is ready to pull at your heartstrings!
author: Anime Corner

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Tops Weekly Summer Ranking for Second Time in a Row After Episode 12
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 topped the Summer 2026 weekly ranking for the second time in a row in Week 11 after its Episode 12 . The anime previously won after the “Turning Point 4” episode, where Rudeus from the future was introduced. Episode 13 revealed the preview images and trailer ahead of its September 20 premiere.

In the latest ranking , the anime took 15.61% of the votes, ranking over Though I Am an Inept Villainess and Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia . You can see the full results , while the top 10 graphic can be found below.

ALSO READ: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Blu-ray Volume 2 Reveals Shirotaka Jacket Artwork Featuring Current and Future Rudeus

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the ongoing arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.

title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2 Reveals Main Visual and January 9 Premiere Date
content:
YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2, the Kaguya Arc , revealed the main anime visual and a January 9, 2027 premiere date. WIT STUDIO is handling the animation for the new adaptation of Gosho Aoyama’s manga, which released its first season last year.

The visual shows Yaiba wielding the Thunder God Sword against Onimaru’s Wind God Sword. Takahiro Hasui directs the anime at WIT STUDIO, with Toko Machida handling series composition and Yoshimichi Kameda serving as character designer and chief animation director. Studio Kurm provides animation production cooperation. You can see the new visual below.

Studio Kurm is a CyberAgent subsidiary established on October 1, 2025, with anime producer Maiko Okada as its president. Okada previously served as animation producer on YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1, which credited WIT STUDIO for animation production. For Season 2, Studio Kurm is credited with the animation production cooperation, while WIT STUDIO remains the main animation studio.

YAIBA (stylized as Y∀IBA ) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by the veteran Gosho Aoyama, who is also known as the creator of Magic Kaito and Case Closed/Detective Conan . The manga was serialized in Shogakukan’s Weekly Shonen Sunday from September 1988 to December 1993. Its got an anime adaptation by studio Pastel in the 90s, and it ran for 52 episodes from April 1993 to April 1994.

The story follows Yaiba Kurogane, a young man who unexpectedly returns to Japan after training in the jungle to become a true samurai. He begins living with the Mine family, and an ancient power awakens following his clash with a skilled kendo practictioner, Takeshi Onimaru. An updated visual was also released:

title: Tamil, Telugu Dubs of Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill Anime Stream on Muse India
content:
The first anime season premiered by streaming exclusively in Japan on Amazon Prime Video and Hikari TV in January 2023. Muse Asia streamed the first season of the anime in India as it aired in Japan. The Muse India YouTube channel then streamed episodes of the anime with Hindi subtitles in roman script. Netflix later added the anime in India. Crunchyroll is streaming the season in India in Japanese and with an English dub . Muse India added a Hindi dub of the season in November 2024.

Kiyoshi Matsuda ( RE-MAIN , Kakegurui season 2, Uchitama?! Have you seen my Tama? ) directed the first anime season at MAPPA . Michiko Yokote ( Cowboy Bebop , Rurouni Kenshin , xxxHOLiC , Shirobako ) oversaw the series scripts, and Nao Ōtsu ( BEASTARS both seasons) adapted Masa 's original character designs for animation. Masato Kōda ( KonoSuba – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!! , Domestic Girlfriend ), Kana Utatane ( KanadeYUK ), and Kuricorder Quartet ( tsuritama ) composed the music.

The second season of Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill premiered in October 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime season in India as it aired in Japan. Muse Asia also streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan as did Netflix , Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times , and JioHotstar. Crunchyroll streamed the Hindi dub of the season on November 12 and the Tamil and Telugu dub on December 3.

Eguchi started publishing the novels on the "Shosetsuka ni Narō" website in 2016, and Overlap is publishing the novels in print. Overlap is also publishing K Akagishi 's manga adaptation in Japan, as well as Momo Futaba 's Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hōrō Meshi: Sui no Daibōken spinoff manga.

J-Novel Club is releasing both the light novel series and K Akagishi 's manga adaptation in English.
author: ANN

title: MMAJ Hosts Makoto Shinkai Film Dubbing Competition, Guests Luna Haruna, Daisuke Hasegawa, More in New Delhi
content:
The event will take place on October 3 and 4 at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi.

The Makoto Shinkai Film Dubbing Competition will take place during both days of the event, but participants must apply online by September 23.

Japanese musicians Kanapon, ERIHIRO, and Re: Like will also perform at the event.

Haruna has provided theme songs for anime such as Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend , Sword Art Online , and Fate/Zero . She launched her Lunamaria brand of wedding dresses in 2016.

Hasegawa performed a theme song for the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable anime. He has also performed a theme song and an insert song for the Gundam: Reconguista in G anime.

Mawatari has worked on the theme songs and insert songs for the 2018 Yū Yū Hakusho OVA , the Yū Yū Hakusho live-action show, Yu Yu Hakusho: Ghost Files , and more shows in the franchise .

SCREEN mode performed the opening theme song for Bungo Stray Dogs 2 — the second television anime adaptation of Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa 's Bungo Stray Dogs manga — and for the original television anime Keishichō Tokumu-bu Tokushu Kyōaku-han Taisaku-Shitsu Dai-Nana-ka -Tokunana- ( Special Crime Investigation Unit Special 7 or literally, Metropolitan Police Department Special Division Heinous Crime Investigation Unit Special 7: Tokunana).

Last year's MMAJ event took place at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi on September 13 and 14. Haruna and Hasegawa performed at the event.

The MMAJ 2024 event took place at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi on September 28 and September 29. The event screened seven anime films including Suzume and Jujutsu Kaisen 0 .
author: ANN

title: Muse Asia Licenses Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine Anime
content:
Muse Asia announced on Thursday that it has licensed Good Smile Company 's original anime Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine), and will begin streaming it in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 7.

The anime stars:

• Takuma Terashima as Gekiha Shijima

• Haruka Shiraishi as Akane Kuzumi

• Saya Aizawa as Kirei Shijima

• Nao Tōyama as Haru

• Aya Yamane as Natsu

• Misaki Kuno as Aki

• Asuna Tomari as Gō Sera

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Yūsaku Kuroiwa

• Ryōtarō Okiayu as Daigo Shijima

• Atsushi Ono as Genjūrō Shijima

• Ruriko Aoki as Yūga Shinonome

Yi Cao is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS and Kayac Animation . Toshiki Inoue (various Kamen Rider series, Death Note ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. robin is designing the characters. Majiro ( Macross Delta ) is the original character designer. An ( GOD BRAVE STUDIO ) is the mechanical designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) is the sound director.

The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets a n invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

Takanori Nishikawa is performing the opening theme song "Zankyō ≠ Blaster," and DayRe: is performing the ending theme song "Mikansei Ordinary" (Incomplete Ordinary).

TOGUCHI is drawing a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Dengeki Daioh magazine.

The anime is the first project in Good Smile Company 's "The God of Combined Series" ("Gattaishin Series"). The anime commemorates Good Smile Company 's 25th anniversary.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Streams FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Friday that it will stream the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 1.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

University student Kurumi Fukuga finally makes her long-awaited debut in Foreign Exchange (FX) Trading, to win back the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll make enough in no time!" With that vow, she dives into a world that can flip from heaven to hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations... Even so, she wants to buy, sell, and make money! Will Kurumi and the others survive this raging world?

The anime stars:

• Aina Suzuki as Kurumi Fukuga

• Asami Seto as Mochiko Kogane

• Ayasa Itō as Mebuki Yamashi

• Miho Okasaki as Yasuko Takane

Yūki Ogawa ( Ōya-san wa Shishunki! , Mieruko-chan , Miru Tights ) is directing the anime at Passione . Kenta Ihara ( Blue Miburo , Sentenced to Be a Hero ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Kazuyuki Ueda ( BanG Dream! (TV 2) , Love Flops , Hinako Note ) is the character designer, and Takurō Iga ( Oshi no Ko , Trillion Game ) is composing the music.

Aina Suzuki as her character Kurumi Fukuga will perform the show's opening theme song "FX Sen shi Kurumi-chan." Suzuki will also perform the ending theme song "$・¥・€."

Asami Seto as Mochiko Kogane
Ayasa Itō as Mebuki Yamashi
Miho Okasaki as Yasuko Takane

Yūki Ogawa ( Ōya-san wa Shishunki! , Mieruko-chan , Miru Tights ) is directing the anime at Passione . Kenta Ihara ( Blue Miburo , Sentenced to Be a Hero ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Kazuyuki Ueda ( BanG Dream! (TV 2) , Love Flops , Hinako Note ) is the character designer, and Takurō Iga ( Oshi no Ko , Trillion Game ) is composing the music.
Aina Suzuki as her character Kurumi Fukuga will perform the show's opening theme song "FX Sen shi Kurumi-chan." Suzuki will also perform the ending theme song "$・¥・€."

title: Sanrio's Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes Smartphone Game Gets Worldwide Release in Fall 2027
content:
Sanrio announced on Saturday its Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes smartphone game will get a worldwide release for iOS and Android in fall 2027. The company is streaming a new promotional video for the game.

The game will be free to play with optional in-app purchases. Ateam Holdings is developing the game with Sanrio . ANN reached out to Ateam regarding the audio and text languages available for the global version of the game, but the company did not respond by press time.

The 18 Knights of Fragaria are divided into three units : Red Bouquet, Blue Bouquet, and Noir Bouquet.

In 2016, the Sanrio Danshi were introduced as a group of boys who love Sanrio products. Sanrio Danshi inspired an anime in 2017.
